scope: All five new titles, every opening and notation paragraph, and listed modified reference paragraphs. Earlier stage 1 source bodies provide context only; no whole-paper audit.
source_verification: All five hashes and last-write timestamps reread at the start of this call and unchanged from stage 1.

paragraph_decisions.reason: Names the actual subject and limiting relation. Information is the exact quantity introduced in the first section; stability is the scientific question already raised by the memory chapters.

Connects the two effects that the chapter compares: uncertainty when reading spikes and random changes driven by those spikes. The recurrent-network and diffusion terms were taught earlier. The final sentence gives the purpose of the proof.

Explains information in plain words before its formal definition, motivates the comparisons section, and preserves the needed distinction between a lower bound and an achieved value. Removing its last sentence could suggest that higher information guarantees lower actual diffusion.

Restores symbols needed immediately in the likelihood and proof after the newly inserted long-delay chapter. The projection link describes what the calculation does, so the reader need not infer its role from the technical name alone.
Identifies the earlier calculation that supplies the three displayed identities. It replaces a false adjacency claim with a useful destination and adds no scientific content.

The linked example supplies the family being specialized. Counterexample and converse are exact mathematical meanings required by this local argument; its surrounding equations show the claim being rejected. The new link avoids an obsolete chapter number.
Identifies the estimation task and the changing object that makes it different from reading a fixed value. Every qualification in the title is needed to describe the chapter.

Establishes cue state, previous storage motion, and later observation in familiar words. Repeating that later waiting permits further motion is necessary to explain why collecting spikes is not simply averaging repeated measurements of a fixed quantity.

Explains the reading order through error separation, equal weighting, motion-aware estimation, limited access and model checks. Time constants and noise assumptions are familiar from the preceding calculation and are needed because later extensions change the bound.

The T versus L reminder prevents storage time being confused with observation duration. J is linked and paraphrased as distinguishability; D and tau keep their exact established meanings. The constant-D and boundary conditions are useful rather than decorative.

Only the added link changes the prose. It restores access to a counterexample now in the preceding information chapter. Pointwise condition and noise weighting are exact terms in the surrounding derivation, which states their objects and conditions.

Shared drive is the source question this measurement chapter answers. The preceding discussion makes clear that drive means a changing neural command. Points to keeps the inferential strength visible.

Starts from observable fixation, defines the two movement terms, then gives the source question. Upstream describes a source before the motor neurons in the signal path, which is explained in the next section. The separate recording and model sentences are needed to prevent evidence being mistaken for direct circuit identification.

Explains why the earlier neural model needs a mechanical output model before comparison with eye movement. Coordinate, diffusion and trajectory refer to objects already taught. This paragraph connects the book path to the experiment rather than merely repeating the first paragraph.

Motivates calibration from larger movements before the small fixation analysis. Same scale supplies a plain meaning for calibration and gain; independence is already taught in the foundation chapter. The closing assumptions are required limits on the variance estimate.

The descriptive links name the two prerequisite teaching locations. Integrator is defined in the paragraph before the attractor connection; the model remains identified as proposed. Removing either link would make the new chapter numbering harder to follow.

States the actual contrast tested by the chapter. Filtered white noise is an exact alternative model, and prior muscle-filter teaching supplies filtered. White noise is formally defined before its equations depend on it.

Explains what the previous fixed-interval estimate cannot decide and why multiple time separations are needed. The recording-error warning is needed to motivate the first section rather than bringing in correction machinery without a reason.

Paraphrases MSD before using its technical name in equations. The two input descriptions use everyday words and explain why muscle smoothing does not by itself settle the origin of displacement growth. The final sentence identifies the interpretive benefit of the calculation.
Provides a destination with a descriptive label. The next displayed equation gives the exact current definition, so this backward link is a reminder rather than an unexplained prerequisite burden.
Can produce is necessary because the model is one possible source, not a uniquely identified biological cause. No specialist label is needed before the concrete memory-circuit description.

Recalls the distinct results from the preceding chapters and states their localization limit before introducing the proposed mechanism. Motor neurons and the physical path are already taught. Removing the limit would change how readers weigh the model.

Motivates checking amount and timing, then the parameters controlling the match. These are the actual circuit and scaling sections. Freedom means how several parameter choices can give a match, which the later limitations section explains; it is familiar wording, not an undefined technical metric.

The link provides the earlier definition while the sentence repeats enough to understand CV locally. The sub-Poisson label is immediately explained using count variability and the specific construction, so the technical word earns its place.

The links name the calculations that explain the time and population factors. Projecting and neutral direction keep the exact meanings taught earlier and are needed to relate variability to lasting coordinate change.
The relation link replaces the chapter number without adding a claim. As a scale and fixed geometry are necessary qualifications for the proportionality that follows.

limits: No edits made. Separate reader-understanding and flow stage remains. Existing whole bodies are not newly approved.
